page.layout: One text column with the running head and page number above it. Below the text, the heading "Lectori" set right-aligned. Right margin: cut-off, faded notes of the adjacent printed page, partly hidden by the scan edge.

p.i: tentiâ, non aliud clamant, id unum profitentur, cunêta cognoscere, & in suis actionibus suâ se cognitione dirigere: Hæc ferè sola Philosophiæ istius elementa, hæc prima lineamenta, quæ ut variis postea coloribus induVcantur, peritis tamen pictoribus non latent: Quod deinceps in Textu vide: quem huc usque Commentario prosecuti sumus: Cui, quando jam domum venit, & res suas agere ingreditur, bene agere & valere.

page.notes: The right strip shows the edge of the adjacent printed page with faded marginal notes (e.g. "Quest.", "Lectoo", "Dogm", "Philosoph"), cut off by the scan edge and largely illegible; only the fragments listed here are partly readable. Faint show-through text in the lower middle of the page is not transcribed. The main text is set in italic with long s rendered as plain s; "induVcantur" is printed as "induc-antur" across a line break with a hyphen, transcribed as "indu-cantur" in the source and kept as printed. The word "istius" and similar long-s forms are written with plain s.
